<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- एक ही सीधी-सादी स्क्रीन -->
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:fillViewport="true"
    android:padding="16dp">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical">

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="@string/title"
            android:textSize="20sp"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:paddingBottom="12dp" />

        <TextView style="@style/Lbl" android:text="@string/lbl_token" />
        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/et_token"
            style="@style/Inp"
            android:hint="@string/hint_token"
            android:inputType="textPassword" />

        <TextView style="@style/Lbl" android:text="@string/lbl_owner" />
        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/et_owner"
            style="@style/Inp"
            android:hint="@string/hint_owner"
            android:inputType="text" />

        <TextView style="@style/Lbl" android:text="@string/lbl_repo" />
        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/et_repo"
            style="@style/Inp"
            android:hint="@string/hint_repo"
            android:inputType="text" />

        <TextView style="@style/Lbl" android:text="@string/lbl_branch" />
        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/et_branch"
            style="@style/Inp"
            android:hint="@string/hint_branch"
            android:inputType="text" />

        <TextView style="@style/Lbl" android:text="@string/lbl_remote" />
        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/et_remote"
            style="@style/Inp"
            android:hint="@string/hint_remote"
            android:inputType="text" />

        <TextView style="@style/Lbl" android:text="@string/lbl_local" />
        <EditText
            android:id="@+id/et_local"
            style="@style/Inp"
            android:hint="@string/hint_local"
            android:inputType="text" />

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/btn_save"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
            android:text="@string/btn_save" />

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/btn_download"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
            android:text="@string/btn_download" />

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/btn_upload"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
            android:text="@string/btn_upload" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
            android:text="@string/lbl_log"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <ScrollView
            android:id="@+id/scroll_log"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="200dp"
            android:background="#11000000"
            android:padding="8dp">

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tv_log"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:textSize="13sp"
                android:typeface="monospace" />
        </ScrollView>

        <Button
            android:id="@+id/btn_clear"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            android:text="@string/btn_clear" />

    </LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>
